newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-FINAL EPSOM DERBY RUNNERS.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-FINAL EPSOM DERBY RUNNERS.

text.p: There are fourteen final acceptors
for the Epsom Derby to be run over 12 furlongs (2.4 kms) on
Saturday (1445 GMT).
